adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, optional chaining causes the push to silently no-op, so team members’ destination calendars collected into `teamDestinationCalendars` are dropped. This matches the finding and is a real behavioral defect on that code path.
